subject: AcmeHealth private VPC post-call recap and next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: AcmeHealth private VPC post-call recap and next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so the team has a single source of truth. Please reply with any corrections.

Summary of pain points and drivers:
- Regulatory/data residency: AcmeHealth needs PHI to remain in US or EU regions and must support customer-driven data deletion.
- Air-gap requirement: Some analysis pipelines must run in an air-gapped environment with no outbound internet except to your internal NTP/DNS.
- Network constraints: Strict egress filtering, limited NAT gateways, and port whitelisting for vendor endpoints.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 type 2, HIPAA controls, and KMS/HSM for key management are mandatory.
- Latency expectations: 100ms p95 for interactive clinician workflows; bulk inference can be batch-oriented.

Goals we heard:
1) Execute a sandbox PoC in a private VPC to validate connectivity and performance (target Q3 start).
2) Confirm deployment model for production (dedicated private VPC or on-prem air-gapped nodes).
3) Provide procurement with an initial SOW, pricing bands, and SLA options.

Action items / next steps:
- I attached the Redwood private deploy checklist and a simple network diagram we referenced (redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf, network-diagram.png). Please confirm that the diagram reflects your NAT/gateway constraints.
- You to share any network constraints doc or firewall rules that we should test against (we discussed acquiring CIDR blocks and proxy details).
- Schedule SRE deep-dive to map firewall rules, cert mgmt, and KMS integration (I proposed Aug 3 below).
- Marissa will prepare an initial SOW and pricing outline for procurement.

Proposed timeline:
- PoC kickoff: early September (subject to procurement timing)
- PoC duration: 2-4 weeks
- Production go-live: Q4 (dependent on approval)

Please let me know if I missed anything. If this looks right, I'll loop in our SRE lead and Marissa will circulate the SOW draft by next week.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the clear recap. This looks accurate from our side. A couple clarifications and a doc attached: acmehealth-network-constraints.pdf.

Clarifications:
- The air-gap will apply only to PHI processing workloads; non-PHI inference can be routed through a controlled egress path.
- For KMS, we need HSM-backed keys; we can discuss integration options but prefer customer-managed keys via our key escrow.
- Procurement asked for pricing tiers and SLA options up front so they can do an early budget pass.

I've attached the network constraints doc that includes our proxy endpoints and required ports. Marissa, looping you for SOW timelines.

Alex Johnson
Director of Engineering, Platform | AcmeHealth
